title: The Finish Line
text: Not every chapter closes the way we want, but as long as we keep going, the story continues.

title: Second Update
text: The cause is reaching more people, and the Instagram account is growing slowly. A few supportive messages have come in, and my life and projects are moving forward. You're still on time to be my first donor. Thank you for sharing my story and stay tuned for future updates.

title: The Starting Line
text: Everything is ready to go! The website is launched, the designs are finalized, I've set up the GoFundMe page, and created the Instagram page—most of the pieces are in place. But the most important one is you! With your support, we can bring this campaign to life. I'm excited to embark on this journey and share every step with you. Stay tuned!
